test_cases.title: Real-Time Matchmaking within 200 ms across platforms
preconditions: Player is logged in to the Arcane Quest platform
Player has a stable internet connection
At least one opponent is online and available for matchmaking

steps.action: Player initiates a matchmaking request
steps.expected_result: Matchmaking request is sent to the server

steps.action: Record the current timestamp T1 before sending the request
steps.expected_result: Timestamp T1 is captured

steps.action: Wait for the matchmaking engine to return a match response
steps.expected_result: Match response is received from the server

steps.action: Record the current timestamp T2 after receiving the match response
steps.expected_result: Timestamp T2 is captured

steps.action: Calculate the time difference (T2 - T1) in milliseconds
steps.expected_result: Time difference is computed

steps.action: Verify that the time difference is less than or equal to 200 ms
steps.expected_result: Time difference is <= 200 ms

steps.action: Verify that the matched opponent is from any platform (PC, console, mobile)
steps.expected_result: Opponent platform is accepted regardless of platform

test_cases.expected_result: Player is matched with an opponent within 200 ms regardless of platform
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: The matchmaking engine pairs a player with an opponent within 200 ms of request, regardless of platform.

test_cases.title: Attempt to establish session without mutual authentication
preconditions: Player is logged in with an expired or invalid authentication token.
Opponent is online but has not provided mutual authentication credentials.

steps.action: Player initiates matchmaking request to the server.
steps.expected_result: Matchmaking request is sent to the server.

steps.action: Server attempts to establish a secure session with the opponent using the provided authentication token.
steps.expected_result: Authentication handshake fails due to missing or invalid credentials.

steps.action: Server rejects the session establishment and displays an error message to the player.
steps.expected_result: No secure peer-to-peer or client-server session is established and gameplay does not start.

test_cases.expected_result: Session establishment fails and gameplay does not start due to lack of mutual authentication.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: A secure peer-to-peer or client-server session is established with mutual authentication before gameplay starts.

test_cases.title: Boundary Test for Session State Synchronization Timing
preconditions: Player A is connected to the matchmaking service and ready to join a session

steps.action: Player A initiates a join request to the matchmaking service.
steps.expected_result: Join request is accepted and session creation is initiated.

steps.action: Measure the elapsed time from the join request to the receipt of the session state synchronization event for all participants.
steps.expected_result: Elapsed time is recorded.

steps.action: Verify that the recorded elapsed time is less than or equal to 100 milliseconds.
steps.expected_result: Session state synchronization occurs within 100 ms.

test_cases.expected_result: All participants receive the synchronized session state within 100 ms of a player joining.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: When a player joins, the session state is synchronized to all participants within 100 ms.

test_cases.title: Verify session remains active for 30 seconds after player disconnects and terminates gracefully thereafter
preconditions: All players are logged into the Arcane Quest Multiplayer Platform.
A multiplayer session with at least three players is active.
Network conditions are stable for the duration of the test.

steps.action: Player A initiates a disconnect from the session.
steps.expected_result: Player A is marked as disconnected but the session remains active.

steps.action: Wait for 20 seconds.
steps.expected_result: The session continues to run and other players can still play.

steps.action: Player A attempts to reconnect to the session.
steps.expected_result: Player A successfully reconnects and resumes gameplay without loss of progress.

steps.action: Player A disconnects again from the session.
steps.expected_result: Player A is marked as disconnected but the session remains active.

steps.action: Wait for 35 seconds.
steps.expected_result: The session terminates gracefully and all remaining players receive a notification that the session has ended due to a player disconnect.

test_cases.expected_result: The session remains active for up to 30 seconds after a player disconnects, allowing reconnection, and terminates gracefully with notifications to remaining players after the timeout.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: If a player disconnects, the session remains active for up to 30 seconds to allow reconnection; after that, the session terminates gracefully and notifies remaining players.

test_cases.title: Negative: Verify system fails to log join event when logging service is down
preconditions: Logging service is intentionally disabled or unreachable
Player is logged into the platform
Player has a valid session ID

steps.action: Player initiates a join request to a new session
steps.expected_result: Join request is sent to the matchmaking service

steps.action: Check the logging service for a new log entry corresponding to the join event
steps.expected_result: No log entry is found

steps.action: Observe system UI for any error messages
steps.expected_result: An error message indicating logging failure is displayed

test_cases.expected_result: The system should log the join event with a timestamp; if it does not, the test fails.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: The system logs all session lifecycle events (join, leave, reconnect, termination) with timestamps for audit.
